_comment: How rtc-ship.sh ships THIS repo. The publishable plugin is the NESTED skills/cc-transcript/ package (its own manifest); the release also carries the cc_transcript.py CLI assets built by .rtc/pre-package.sh (scripts/build-release.py), so the Homebrew tap's bump-formulas auto-bump picks up every release. tag_prefix is bare v again: the cc-transcript-v prefix only existed to avoid colliding with the existing v0.8.4 tag while the version surfaces still read 0.8.4 (commit d5aef9f); all surfaces are unified at 0.9.0 now, and the tap bump only accepts v<version> tags. No plugin refresh: source-only install state.
_comment_assets: Built by .rtc/pre-package.sh, which wipes dist/claude-code-transcript-distiller-* and dist/SHA256SUMS before building, so these globs match exactly the current release. rtc-ship fails the ship when a glob matches nothing or a version-bearing asset name carries a different version.
